title: ZTIE collected-record (join) data contract (v1)
description: The derived, bounded COLLECTED record produced by the Story 2.6 JOIN (RD-029) for one intake artifact forked into BOTH inspection lanes concurrently (static 2.1/2.2 + dynamic 2.3), and the SEVENTH envelope kind on the Forensic -> Hub RD-013 gate. It ties the two already-crossed per-lane derived outputs together for one intake_id, ready for Phase-3 aggregation: it records WHICH lanes routing expected, WHETHER each lane completed / errored / was not-applicable (so a one-lane failure is RECORDED, not lost), and a bounded roll-up + Forensic pointer for each (static: highest_severity + findings pointer; dynamic: outcome + run-log pointer). It REFERENCES — never duplicates — the per-lane detail; the full findings document and the full command log stay in Forensic (RD-009). It is NOT a verdict: there is NO verdict/safe/approved/forward/pass_fail/malicious field anywhere; both_complete is a JOIN-completeness fact, lane_status/outcome/highest_severity are EVIDENCE, and the verdict is Hub-side/human-gated (Phase 4). Allow-list: additionalProperties false at every level; every field typed and enum/length/range-bounded. Integrity-keyed by intake_id + sha256. DERIVED-ONLY. OWN version pin (COLLECTED_CONTRACT_VERSION) + a UNIQUE 'collected' discriminator that does not collide with any other envelope kind.

contract_version.description: Collected-record-contract schema version. Pinned SEPARATELY on the Hub validator (COLLECTED_CONTRACT_VERSION) so this envelope kind versions independently of the other six kinds (never rides the shared CONTRACT_VERSION). The Hub rejects unknown-version envelopes fail-closed.

intake_id.description: The intake UUIDv4 this collected record is for. The Hub upserts the joined record onto the tracking record keyed by this.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the raw artifact body both lanes inspected. Integrity key, bound to intake_id; the Hub rejects a collected record whose sha256 does not match the tracked record.

joined_at.description: RFC3339/ISO-8601 UTC timestamp (Z-suffixed) the join produced this collected record in Forensic.

collected.description: The joined COLLECTED record: the per-lane bounded status roll-ups (static + dynamic, by reference) and the join facts (which lanes routing expected, which reported, whether both completed). It references — never duplicates — the per-lane evidence (RD-009). EVIDENCE only; no verdict anywhere. both_complete says whether both expected lanes reported, NOT whether the artifact is safe.

lanes_expected.description: The set of lanes routing (Story 1.3) expected for this artifact. The join is measured against this — a lane routing expected but that never reported is visible as expected-but-not-collected.

lanes_collected.description: The set of lanes whose per-lane summary was actually collected into this record (lane_status 'completed' or 'errored'). A lane routing expected but missing here is a recorded gap, not a silent drop.

both_complete.description: True iff every lane routing expected reported (lane_status 'completed'). A JOIN-completeness fact for Phase-3 aggregation — NOT a safety verdict; a fully-collected record can still describe a high-severity finding or an execution_error.

static.description: The bounded STATIC-lane roll-up for this intake, by reference. It records whether the static lane completed / errored / was not-applicable, and (when it completed) the worst severity it rolled up plus a POINTER back to the full findings document in Forensic (RD-009). It does NOT re-embed the per-finding detail — that stays in Forensic. EVIDENCE, never a verdict.

lane.description: The lane this status is for. Always 'static_analysis' (matches the routing contract's lane enum and the static-scan-summary lane).

lane_status.description: Whether the static lane completed / errored / was not-applicable for this intake. A failed OR skipped lane is RECORDED here, never dropped. NOT a verdict.

highest_severity.description: The worst normalized severity the static lane rolled up (by reference to the crossed static-scan-summary; 'none' when there were zero findings). Present when the lane completed. A descriptive roll-up of EVIDENCE — NOT a decision about the artifact.

total_findings.description: Optional total finding count rolled up from the static-scan summary, by reference. Bounded; the full findings document stays in Forensic (RD-009).

summary_contract_version.description: Optional version of the static-scan-summary contract this roll-up was collected from, for traceability.

findings_s3_bucket.description: Optional Forensic S3 bucket holding the full normalized findings document (RD-009 — the full document stays in Forensic; only this pointer crosses). Referenced, not duplicated.

findings_s3_key.description: Optional Forensic S3 key of the full normalized findings document (findings/<intake_id>/static-findings.json).

error_reason.description: Optional short, bounded, non-executable reason when lane_status is 'errored'. Never raw content.

dynamic.description: The bounded DYNAMIC-lane roll-up for this intake, by reference. It records whether the dynamic lane completed / errored / was not-applicable, and (when it ran) the controlled-run outcome plus a POINTER back to the full command log in Forensic (RD-009). It does NOT re-embed the run detail — that stays in Forensic. EVIDENCE, never a verdict.

lane.description: The lane this status is for. Always 'dynamic_detonation' (matches the routing contract's lane enum and the dynamic-run outcome lane).

lane_status.description: Whether the dynamic lane completed / errored / was not-applicable for this intake. A failed OR skipped lane is RECORDED here, never dropped. NOT a verdict.

outcome.description: The controlled-run outcome rolled up from the crossed dynamic-run envelope (completed / execution_error / launch_error / timed_out / delivery_error). Present when the lane ran. Describes how the ORCHESTRATION ended — NOT whether the artifact is safe.

run_contract_version.description: Optional version of the dynamic-run contract this roll-up was collected from, for traceability.

run_log_s3_bucket.description: Optional Forensic S3 bucket holding the full command output log (RD-009 — the full log stays in Forensic; only this pointer crosses). Referenced, not duplicated.

run_log_s3_key.description: Optional Forensic S3 key of the full command output log (runs/<intake_id>/detonation-output.json).

error_reason.description: Optional short, bounded, non-executable reason when lane_status is 'errored'. Never raw content.

join_note.description: Optional short, bounded, non-executable operator note about the join (e.g. 'dynamic lane not applicable for iac_template' or 'static lane errored; recorded'). Never raw content, never a verdict.
